topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I just got home, and my driveway is empty. My car, gone. I've been driving that thing for years, and now it's just... not here. The neighbors say they saw a tow truck earlier. I checked everywhere, even the impound lot down the street. Nothing. I need that car. How am I supposed to get to work? I don't have the money for a new one right now, or even the time to deal with this. I've got bills to pay, and all of this is just adding up. I can't wait around; I need to figure this out. My life is on hold until I find my car.
